proposed_comments.title: Marshal rich details content updates and clean stale view models

confidence.rationale: The PR adds DetailsViewModel.Content as an ObservableCollection bound from XAML, but the current rebuild mutates it directly from extension notifications and does not clean removed or failed child view models. The replacement follows the existing page scheduler and SafeCleanup patterns.

proposed_comments.title: Avoid rebuilding content twice when the model has ItemsChanged

confidence.rationale: Toolkit Details raises both property and item notifications after the contract change. Keeping the legacy PropChanged path only for non-ItemsChanged implementations avoids duplicate rebuilds while preserving compatibility.

proposed_comments.title: Track content notification and cleanup state

confidence.rationale: The rebuilt details content needs stable state for ItemsChanged subscription, stale rebuild suppression, and HasContent binding. The fields are directly consumed by the scheduled rebuild and cleanup paths.

proposed_comments.title: Import threading primitives used by details refreshes

confidence.rationale: The proposed stale-generation and cleanup guards use Interlocked and Volatile, so System.Threading must be imported for the DetailsViewModel changes to compile.

proposed_comments.title: Collapse the rich-content repeater when details have no content

confidence.rationale: The PR adds a margin-bearing ItemsRepeater before metadata. When Content is empty it still contributes spacing; binding visibility to HasContent removes the empty gap.

proposed_comments.body:
### Collapse the rich-content repeater when details have no content

**Severity:** `low`

The new rich-content repeater has a non-zero bottom margin, so details pages without rich content still reserve extra vertical space before metadata. Binding visibility to `HasContent` keeps existing details layouts unchanged when `GetContent()` is empty.

```suggestion
                        <ItemsRepeater
                            Grid.Row="3"
                            Margin="0,4,0,16"
                            IsTabStop="False"
                            ItemTemplate="{StaticResource DetailsContentTemplateSelector}"
                            ItemsSource="{x:Bind ViewModel.Details.Content, Mode=OneWay}"
                            Layout="{StaticResource DetailsContentLayout}"
                            Visibility="{x:Bind ViewModel.Details.HasContent, Mode=OneWay}" />
```

> If applying multiple suggestions in this file individually, use "Commit suggestion" from bottom to top, or batch the suggestions and commit them atomically.

proposed_comments.title: Render tree content in details

confidence.rationale: The PR exposes the shared content model in details but omits TreeTemplate from the selector, so TreeContent returned by GetContent has no matching template in the details pane.

proposed_comments.body:
### Render tree content in details

**Severity:** `medium`

`IDetails2.GetContent()` can return the same content types as a content page, including `TreeContent`, but the details selector currently has no tree template. That leaves tree content without a render path in the details pane. Add a details tree template and wire it into the selector, reusing the details content selector for nested root and child content.

```suggestion
            <cmdpalUI:ContentTemplateSelector
                x:Key="DetailsContentTemplateSelector"
                FormTemplate="{StaticResource DetailsFormContentTemplate}"
                ImageTemplate="{StaticResource DetailsImageContentTemplate}"
                MarkdownTemplate="{StaticResource DetailsMarkdownContentTemplate}"
                PlainTextTemplate="{StaticResource DetailsPlainTextContentTemplate}"
                TreeTemplate="{StaticResource DetailsTreeContentTemplate}" />

            <DataTemplate x:Key="DetailsFormContentTemplate" x:DataType="viewModels:ContentFormViewModel">
                <cpcontrols:ContentFormControl ViewModel="{x:Bind}" />
            </DataTemplate>

            <DataTemplate x:Key="DetailsMarkdownContentTemplate" x:DataType="viewModels:ContentMarkdownViewModel">
                <tkcontrols:MarkdownTextBlock
                    Config="{StaticResource DefaultMarkdownConfig}"
                    Text="{x:Bind Body, Mode=OneWay}"
                    UseEmphasisExtras="True"
                    UsePipeTables="True" />
            </DataTemplate>

            <DataTemplate x:Key="DetailsPlainTextContentTemplate" x:DataType="viewModels:ContentPlainTextViewModel">
                <extViews:PlainTextContentViewer
                    Text="{x:Bind Text, Mode=OneWay}"
                    UseMonospace="{x:Bind UseMonospace, Mode=OneWay}"
                    WordWrapEnabled="{x:Bind WordWrapEnabled, Mode=OneWay}" />
            </DataTemplate>

            <DataTemplate x:Key="DetailsImageContentTemplate" x:DataType="viewModels:ContentImageViewModel">
                <extViews:ImageContentViewer DataContext="{x:Bind}" />
            </DataTemplate>

            <DataTemplate x:Key="NestedDetailsFormContentTemplate" x:DataType="viewModels:ContentFormViewModel">
                <cpcontrols:ContentFormControl ViewModel="{x:Bind}" />
            </DataTemplate>

            <DataTemplate x:Key="NestedDetailsMarkdownContentTemplate" x:DataType="viewModels:ContentMarkdownViewModel">
                <tkcontrols:MarkdownTextBlock Config="{StaticResource DefaultMarkdownConfig}" Text="{x:Bind Body, Mode=OneWay}" />
            </DataTemplate>

            <DataTemplate x:Key="DetailsTreeContentTemplate" x:DataType="viewModels:ContentTreeViewModel">
                <StackPanel Orientation="Vertical">
                    <ItemsRepeater
                        VerticalAlignment="Stretch"
                        ItemTemplate="{StaticResource DetailsContentTemplateSelector}"
                        ItemsSource="{x:Bind Root, Mode=OneWay}"
                        Layout="{StaticResource DetailsContentLayout}" />

                    <ItemsRepeater
                        Margin="8,8,0,0"
                        VerticalAlignment="Stretch"
                        ItemsSource="{x:Bind Children, Mode=OneWay}"
                        Layout="{StaticResource DetailsContentLayout}"
                        Visibility="{x:Bind HasChildren, Mode=OneWay}">
                        <ItemsRepeater.ItemTemplate>
                            <cmdpalUI:ContentTemplateSelector
                                FormTemplate="{StaticResource NestedDetailsFormContentTemplate}"
                                ImageTemplate="{StaticResource DetailsImageContentTemplate}"
                                MarkdownTemplate="{StaticResource NestedDetailsMarkdownContentTemplate}"
                                PlainTextTemplate="{StaticResource DetailsPlainTextContentTemplate}"
                                TreeTemplate="{StaticResource DetailsTreeContentTemplate}" />
                        </ItemsRepeater.ItemTemplate>
                    </ItemsRepeater>
                </StackPanel>
            </DataTemplate>
```

> If applying multiple suggestions in this file individually, use "Commit suggestion" from bottom to top, or batch the suggestions and commit them atomically.

proposed_comments.title: Keep the type-cache stub compatible with IDetails2 notifications

confidence.rationale: After IDetails2 requires INotifyItemsChanged, the type-cache stub must implement the event or it no longer satisfies the interface. No-op accessors are enough because this object is only an ABI/type cache sentinel.

proposed_comments.title: Raise ItemsChanged when toolkit details content changes

confidence.rationale: The PR adds mutable Details.Content, but the host otherwise has no contract-defined signal to refresh after an extension changes it. Raising ItemsChanged on a successful setter change mirrors existing list/content-page notification patterns.

proposed_comments.title: Add the ItemsChanged event state to toolkit details

confidence.rationale: The contract-level notification requires Windows.Foundation.TypedEventHandler and a backing content field so the setter can determine whether content actually changed before notifying.

proposed_comments.title: Make rich details content refreshable through the contract

confidence.rationale: IDetails2.GetContent is a method rather than a projected observable collection, so the interface needs an explicit item-change signal. INotifyItemsChanged is already the extension contract used for mutable content collections.

proposed_comments.title: Complete details content cleanup for teardown and replacement

confidence.rationale: The current changed code creates child content view models that subscribe to extension models, but the existing cleanup method only unsubscribes from IDetails.PropChanged and the form content file is outside the current PR diff. This requires coordinated edits outside reviewable right-side ranges.

proposed_comments.body:
### Complete details content cleanup for teardown and replacement

**Severity:** `high`

The rich details content path creates child content view models that can subscribe to extension objects, but the current cleanup path only removes the `IDetails.PropChanged` handler. Please make details cleanup terminal, unsubscribe the `INotifyItemsChanged` handler, clear and clean the current content collection on the page scheduler, and ensure form content view models unsubscribe from `IFormContent.PropChanged` when they are removed. GitHub cannot offer a safe apply button for the full change because part of the required cleanup is outside the current PR diff.

proposed_comments.title: Add regression coverage for rich details lifetime behavior

confidence.rationale: The reviewed behavior spans scheduler dispatch, stale refresh ordering, exception cleanup, and subscription cleanup. The PR currently has no test-file diff where an inline suggestion can be anchored.

proposed_comments.body:
### Add regression coverage for rich details lifetime behavior

**Severity:** `medium`

Please add unit coverage for rich details content creation, `ItemsChanged`-driven refresh, stale refresh ordering, exception cleanup, replacement cleanup, and cleanup followed by a late initialization call. These cases protect the new content surface from UI-thread mutations and retained extension subscriptions. GitHub cannot offer an apply button because the relevant test file is not part of the current PR diff.
